I am an old man with many years on the land here in Oromia. This plot is not mine, I rent it, so I do not want to spend too much money on it — the owner takes his share and fertilizer is expensive and often comes late from the cooperative. I will put a little DAP if I can get it, and I will spread manure from my cattle because I have animals on my 5 hectares. I never learned to read, so I stay with the seed I know, and my sons and I will do most of the work ourselves, hiring only a few people at weeding and harvest time.
